content.text:
I submitted **index 4 (Sb fraction 0.21)** as the best composition. At 0.065%, it had the highest EQE of the five I measured. All 5 EQE measurements are used; I used 3 of the 5 XRD measurements.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.12 | 0.053 |
| **4** | **0.21** | **0.065** |
| 6 | 0.25 | 0.046 |
| 14 | 0.49 | ≈ 0 |
| 24 | 0.75 | ≈ 0 |

- **Where the peak is:** only the iron-rich end of the line gives any response. EQE rises from 0.12 to 0.21 and has already dropped by 0.25, so the best composition is probably near 0.2.
- **Gaps:** I didn't measure indices 1–3 or 5, so the true optimum could be one of those neighbours and slightly higher than index 4. Anything above 0.25 was covered by only two measurements, both near zero, so a second, separate peak there can't be ruled out.
- **Crystal structure:** the XRD patterns at 0.12, 0.21 and 0.33 look essentially the same, and none shows a clear separate iron-oxide phase. I didn't compare them against simulated patterns, so which phase this is remains unconfirmed.

The EQE values are all very low (below 0.1%) because the line as a whole performs poorly under these conditions.
